name: Eaagads Limited
source: kenyanstocks.com financial statements API, EGAD assets, liabilities and shareholder's equity, years 2024 and 2025, KES absolute. 2024 and 2025 are the audited statements for the financial years ended 31 March 2024 and 31 March 2025. Non-current assets are Property, Plant and Equipment plus the Right-of-Use Asset; Current assets are Inventories, Amounts Due From Related Parties, Biological Assets, Cash and Bank Balances, Corporation Tax Recoverable and Trade and Other Receivables; Non-current liabilities are the Deferred Tax Liability, Non-current Retirement Benefit Obligations and Long Service Awards; Current liabilities are Amounts Due To Related Parties, Corporation Tax Payable, the Crop Debenture Short Term Loan, Current Retirement Benefit Obligations and Trade and Other Payables; Total equity is Share Capital, Revaluation Reserve and Retained Earnings. Total assets equal total liabilities plus total equity exactly in both years, and the same mapping reproduces the already stored FY2023 and FY2022 figures to the shilling.
